notes.title: Patch update released March 29, 2022
notes.content:
Hi TGWS players! 

Thanks very much to Steam user jkly for reporting the movement bug in the final battle! We have fixed that with the latest update that we released this past Tuesday, March 29, 2022. 

We hope you all enjoy adventuring in magical Mindanao ːsteamhappyː

-Interintellectus NFP

notes.title: Steam Achievements and more in October 24 update!
notes.content:
Dear players, 

We have released some fun new content for you all!
[list]
[*]added Steam Achievements
[*] changed Albularya heat controls
[*]added Fely VO
[*]added Tonying VO
[*] added Lily idle dialogue
[*]added sfx for Jak En Poy
[*]fixed save file issues
[/list]

Look out for another update soon. Thanks for playing The Girl Who Sees!
